description: PostgreSQL 18 XML validation, declaration normalization, SQL/XML constructors and predicates, XPath namespaces, XMLTABLE projection, aggregation, storage, arrays, and catalog identity
sql: SELECT xml '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="LATIN1"?><root>é</root>', xml '<?xml version="1.1" encoding="UTF-8"?><root/>', xml_is_well_formed('<a/>'), xml_is_well_formed_document('<a/><b/>'), xml_is_well_formed_content('<a/><b/>');
SELECT xmlparse(document '<root><a/></root>'), xmlparse(content '<a/><b/>'), xmlserialize(document xml '<a/>' AS text), xmlexists('/root/a' PASSING BY VALUE xml '<root><a/></root>');
SELECT xmlelement(name patient, xmlattributes(42 AS id, NULL AS omitted), xmlforest('Ada & Bob' AS name, xml '<b/>' AS payload)), xmlpi(name php, 'echo 1;'), xmlcomment('reviewed');
SELECT xmlroot(xml '<a/>', version '1.1', standalone yes), xmlroot(xml '<a/>', version no value, standalone no value), xmlconcat(xml '<a/>', NULL, xml '<b/>');
SELECT xpath('/root/a/text()', xml 'onetwo'), xpath_exists('/root/a[@id="x"]', xml '');
SELECT xpath('/r:root/r:item', xml '<r:root xmlns:r="urn:test"><r:item id="1">A</r:item></r:root>', ARRAY[ARRAY['r', 'urn:test']]);

SELECT xml '<!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY x "bar">]><foo>&x;</foo>', xpath('string(/foo)', xml '<!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY x "bar">]><foo>&x;</foo>'), xml '<!DOCTYPE foo SYSTEM "file:///does-not-exist"><foo>&external;</foo>';

SELECT id, name, ordinality FROM XMLTABLE(XMLNAMESPACES('urn:test' AS r), '/r:rows/r:row' PASSING xml '<r:rows xmlns:r="urn:test"><r:row id="7"><r:name>A</r:name></r:row><r:row id="8"/></r:rows>' COLUMNS id int PATH '@id', name text PATH 'r:name' DEFAULT 'missing', ordinality FOR ORDINALITY) ORDER BY id;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_xml (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload XML, fragments XML[]);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_xml VALUES (2, xml '<b/>', ARRAY[xml '<b/>', NULL]), (1, xml '<a/>', ARRAY[xml '<a/>']);
SELECT xmlagg(payload ORDER BY id), pg_typeof(xmlagg(payload)), xmlagg(payload) FILTER (WHERE id = 1) FROM type_matrix_xml;
SELECT id, payload, fragments FROM type_matrix_xml ORDER BY id;
SELECT oid, typarray FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'xml';
